plugin.name: The Punisher Widescreen Fix
ResX.description: Override rendering width. If either dimension is zero, use the desktop resolution. Requires a restart.
ResY.description: Override rendering height. If either dimension is zero, use the desktop resolution. Requires a restart.
FOVFactor.description: Multiplies the corrected world-camera FOV from 0.5 to 2.0; larger is wider. Applies immediately, including scripted world cameras. Portraits and menu views keep their original framing.
SkipIntro.description: Skip the intro sequence. Requires a restart.
HudAspectRatioConstraint.description: Auto uses the whole screen width. A ratio such as 16:9 keeps the HUD in a centered box of that aspect. Applies immediately.
FMVWidescreenMode.description: Keep the original aspect with black borders, crop to fill the screen, or stretch. Applies immediately.
menu.title: Plugins
menu.settingsfilehelp: Shows the settings file in File Explorer
menu.presethelp: Vanilla: as released. Recommended: the defaults. Enhanced: everything turned up.
menu.restoredefaultshelp: Sets the settings of this page to their defaults.
menu.restartwarning: The game must be restarted to apply some settings.
FPSLimit.description: Limits rendering to 30–1000 FPS. 0 disables the limit; -1 uses the desktop refresh rate. Applies immediately. 60 FPS is recommended for stable game behavior.
